conceptual_change: Introduce a conditional execution block that validates the volatility-gate (ATR(14) > 1.5 * SMA(ATR(14), 20)) prior to signal generation to filter out low-volatility noise.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The failure analysis for BC 13 indicated the strategy was unexecutable due to a lack of an engine-level volatility-gate implementation. By formalizing this logic into the hypothesis, we enable a testable constraint on the entry criteria to improve signal quality.
